courses.note: Elective for the general BS CS; required within the optional AI emphasis. The undergraduate catalog includes this 5000-level course (.cache/text/v2c-missouri-science-and-technology-C5-1.txt). Department rotation lists it every spring (https://cs.mst.edu/graduate-degrees/, saved as -C5-4.txt); Spring 2026 is confirmed by a current teaching page (https://sid-nadendla.github.io/teaching.html, saved as -C5-2.txt). Both introductory courses have annual rotations: COMP SCI 5400 every spring and COMP SCI 5420 every fall. Selected introductory AI to resolve the frequency tie. The Spring 2019 distance listing names a syllabus but the fetched text contains only schedule/catalog information, not a syllabus (https://dce.mst.edu/Content_Repository/soc/classes/xdis/sp2019/CompSci54001DIS/index.html, saved as -C5-3.txt). No readable public syllabus found, including for 2025-26.
